subject.title: Create example OpenClaw plugin using before_install

question: Should ClawScan own a repo-hosted OpenClaw `before_install` example plugin, or should this remain an external OpenClaw plugin package until the boundary is clearer?
rationale: The requested work is useful for security workflow demonstration, but it adds plugin/package/config surface around install-time policy and current VISION.md keeps ClawScan CLI-first until maintainers approve that expansion.

options.title: Keep external first
options.body: Publish or preserve the plugin as a separate OpenClaw package and revisit repo inclusion only after maintainers confirm ClawScan should own this example.

options.title: Sponsor repo-hosted example
options.body: Approve a narrow PR that adds only the plugin package, local proof, tests, and docs without public ClawScan CLI expansion or README roadmap claims.

options.title: Close after external publication
options.body: If the example is published elsewhere and no ClawScan code or docs change remains, close this issue with a link to that package.

recommendation.title: Keep external first
recommendation.body: Publish or preserve the plugin as a separate OpenClaw package and revisit repo inclusion only after maintainers confirm ClawScan should own this example.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the default code owner and owns the off-main branch that already contains the candidate plugin work.
